questions.q: When did Thoreau begin his two‑year retreat at Walden Pond?
questions.why: The text states the retreat started in September 1845.

questions.q: Which four basics of life did Thoreau focus on during his stay?
questions.why: The text lists food, shelter, clothing, and keeping the fireplace alit.

questions.q: What seasonal challenge made Thoreau's tasks harder but more rewarding?
questions.why: Winter is described as the most challenging season that increased reward.

questions.q: What does Thoreau claim is more valuable than love, money, or fame?
questions.why: He is quoted saying "Rather than love, than money, than fame, give me truth."

questions.q: Who allowed Thoreau to build his cabin on the land?
questions.why: Emerson permitted Thoreau to live on his woodland for the retreat.
